title: Interested in finding out if anyone else has had this reoccurring dream?
content: I’ve had this same reoccurring dream on and off since I was a kid. I’m in a carnival, or a fair, and everything is going fine until I start looking at people’s faces. Their faces turn orange and then ants start crawling all over their faces. They then start chasing me, I run and run. Until I climb underneath a ride and I’m hiding below it while they all Look for me.
